_comment: Shapes for tests/unit/copies/test_enters_as_copy_add_abilities.py. t_eaxa_effigy is Machine God's Effigy whole: an artifact that may enter as a copy of any creature on the battlefield, except it's an artifact and it has the quoted '{T}: Add {U}.', written once under grantable_abilities and named by add_abilities; uncopied it has the same mana ability printed. t_eaxa_mirror is the same exception until end of turn, with no printed ability of its own, so its quoted ability is visible only while it copies.

cards.name: Test Mana Effigy
cards.oracle_text:
